cohort: MILK10k clinical close-up strict six-class subset
analysis_role: Additional external transport evaluation; the existing DermatoNet analysis is exploratory and remains separately reported

diagnosis_policy.ACK: Solar or actinic keratosis only; exclude SCC in situ/Bowen
diagnosis_policy.MEL: Primary invasive melanoma and melanoma in situ; exclude melanoma metastasis
diagnosis_policy.SCC: Squamous cell carcinoma, Invasive only; exclude keratoacanthoma and in situ
diagnosis_policy.SEK: Seborrheic keratosis only; exclude other BKL

eligibility: One clinical close-up per lesion; no dermoscopic input; retain missing age using original training-fitted imputation and flag; no outcome-based exclusions
sex_information_limit: All distributed records have sex recorded. C-B tests transport of separately trained models, not an association between missingness and diagnosis within this cohort; do not manufacture missingness for primary evaluation.
age: Released age_approx in five-year bins is used as supplied; use each model original inner-training mean/std/median, never fit on MILK10k
patient_linkage: No patient identifiers provided. Cluster unit is lesion; patient dependence and overlap remain unverified.
freeze: Complete and freeze all planned new training before formal new external evaluation; register checksums of models/configs and final cohort lock; no fine-tuning, no external selection of checkpoints/seeds/preprocessing
preprocessing: Use original deterministic build_transforms(224): Resize(256,256), CenterCrop(224), ToTensor, ImageNet normalization; preserve training metadata ordering and encoding
aggregation: Compute each frozen model separately. For recalls/BACC use original PAD class-specific test-fold support weights. For NLL/Brier use original PAD total-image test-fold support weights. No probability ensemble; report all three seeds and seed SD.
secondary_contrasts: DSMAF B versus image-only with architecture-confounding limitation

intervals.coverage: 95% percentile conditional on fitted models and released lesions; not patient-cluster intervals; training variability shown separately

duplicate_policy: Before outcomes: exact bytes and decoded-pixel hashes within candidates and against all available PAD/DermatoNet images; pHash candidate screening followed by manual review. Cross-cohort confirmed duplicate groups excluded from MILK10k. Within-MILK repeated confirmed images across lesions excluded as whole groups. Preserve all exclusion reasons. Absence of image match does not prove patient independence.
additional_prespecified_sensitivity: Histopathology-only subset, same frozen models, no retraining; report class support and avoid claiming it resolves reference-standard bias
precision: Local feasibility test CPU float32. Formal device/precision must be documented before outcomes; original AMD iGPU is not a CUDA device. CPU performance tests use synthetic inputs only.
publication: No clinical images or case-level metadata automatically published; original official access links and attribution retained.
